title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
gist: Google is widening Gemini Intelligence, its Android-level AI layer, to more OEM and prior-generation hardware (Motorola's first device, motorola signature 27, plus Pixel 10 via Pixel Drop) and adding agentic features: prompt-built widgets (Create My Widget), on-device troubleshooting (Device Assistance), cross-app task automation expanding to the UK, India and Japan, and proactive suggestions on Android Auto.

insights.claim: Motorola is launching its first Gemini Intelligence device, the motorola signature 27, available for pre-order in the U.S. on November 19, 2026.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: Adds another Android OEM to Google's premium AI-layer program, broadening Gemini's distribution beyond Pixel and Samsung.
insights.quote: Motorola is introducing its first Gemini Intelligence device, motorola signature 27, which is available for pre-order in the U.S. on November 19.

insights.claim: Google is back-porting Gemini Intelligence features to prior-generation Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro XL and Pixel 10 Pro Fold via a Pixel Drop software update, rather than limiting them to the new Pixel 11.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: Expands the installed base for Gemini's on-device features without new hardware sales; watch whether it dampens Pixel 11 upgrade incentives.

insights.claim: Gemini Intelligence devices began rolling out in summer 2026 starting with the Pixel 11 and Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Z Fold8, Z Flip8 and S26 series.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: Samsung's flagship line is a launch partner, making Gemini the default AI layer on the largest premium Android installed base.
insights.locator: Earlier this year, we announced Gemini Intelligence

insights.claim: Google positions Gemini Intelligence as spanning screens beyond phones, having launched Googlebook in October 2026 as the first laptop designed for Gemini Intelligence, with Create My Widget also coming to Pixel Watch in the following weeks.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: Signals Google building a cross-device Gemini ecosystem (phone, laptop, watch, car) to compete with Apple's integrated hardware strategy.
insights.quote: Last month we launched Googlebook, the first laptop designed for Gemini Intelligence.
insights.locator: Experience proactive help across a range of screens

insights.claim: Gemini's task automation, which handles logistics such as ordering food, hailing rides and booking reservations across third-party apps, is expanding to the UK, India and Japan.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: An AI agent intermediating food delivery, ride-hailing and reservation apps shifts the customer interface toward Google; watch implications for app-level aggregators in these markets.

insights.claim: Device Assistance lets users ask Gemini to control, change or fix their Android device, e.g. clearing storage, auditing which apps can access location, or muting distractions while letting important calls through.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: OS-level agentic control is a capability third-party assistants cannot easily replicate, reinforcing Google's platform advantage on Android.
insights.quote: Gemini deeply understands your device so it can act as your personal device expert.
insights.locator: Get personalized tech support with Device Assistance

insights.claim: Gemini Intelligence on Android Auto will surface proactive suggestions from a Pixel phone by connecting context across apps, e.g. finding a confirmation email and offering one-tap sending of a meeting address in reply to a friend's text.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: Shows Google moving from reactive voice commands to proactive, cross-app agents in the car, a new engagement surface.
insights.locator: And if you have a Pixel phone with Gemini Intelligence

insights.claim: Create My Widget, rolling out over the next few weeks, lets Android users generate a personalized homescreen widget from a natural-language description with no coding, pulling data from Gmail, Calendar and Search.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: Prompt-generated UI tied to Google first-party data deepens lock-in to Google services on Android.
insights.quote: lets you design a personalized widget with a simple description in your own words — no coding required.
insights.locator: Build custom widgets with a prompt

insights.claim: Rambler, which converts spoken thoughts into clean, organized text in real time, is now available on the Pixel 10 line and the motorola signature 27.
insights.speaker: Karthik Thirumalai
insights.so_what: Real-time voice-to-text cleanup on non-Google OEM hardware shows Gemini features are not Pixel-exclusive, a point for Android-wide distribution.
